title: AI Customer Support
impact: Enhanced customer support experience with emotion-aware, multilingual, and secure AI interactions
description: A high-fidelity AI-powered customer support system designed for ecommerce, combining intelligent orchestration, sentiment awareness, multilingual interaction, and real-time data grounding.
challenge: Traditional customer support systems lack contextual understanding, emotional awareness, and secure access to user-specific data, leading to poor user experience and unreliable responses.
approach: Built an AI orchestration system that integrates sentiment detection, multilingual processing, and factual data injection to ensure accurate, context-aware, and personalized responses.
solution: Developed a full-stack platform using Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB with Groq-powered LLM execution, enabling real-time, emotion-aware conversations with strict data isolation and grounded responses.
features: Intelligent AI orchestration using Llama 3.3 for context-aware reasoning
Sentiment detection engine (anger, frustration, joy) with adaptive responses
Real-time visual feedback with emoji-based reactions
Multilingual support (English, Hindi, Gujarati, and more)
Voice interface with speech-to-text interaction
Session-based data isolation for secure user-specific access
Factual data injection pipeline to ensure grounded responses
Prompt guard system to restrict AI within ecommerce context

title: AI Resume generator
focus: AI Content Generation & UX-Driven Workflow Systems
impact: Streamlined resume creation with structured AI-generated content and high-fidelity export capabilities
description: An AI-powered resume generation platform that transforms raw career data into professionally structured resumes using Google Gemini, delivered through a guided multi-step workflow.
challenge: Creating high-quality resumes requires structured input, strong writing, and proper formatting, which can be difficult for users without guidance or domain expertise.
approach: Designed a guided 7-step workflow system combined with AI-driven content generation to standardize input collection, improve output quality, and ensure a seamless user experience.
solution: Built a full-stack application that collects structured user data, processes it through a backend prompt pipeline, and generates high-quality resume content rendered in real-time with export support.
features: 7-step guided wizard for structured resume data collection
Comprehensive input coverage (contact, social links, skills, experience, projects, academics, achievements)
Fresher mode support for users without prior work experience
AI-powered generation of summaries and action-oriented bullet points using Gemini 2.5 Flash
Real-time resume preview based on AI-generated structured output
High-fidelity PDF export using html2canvas and jsPDF with multi-page support
Automatic local storage persistence for session recovery
JSON import/export for data portability and reuse
Premium glassmorphic UI with dark mode and micro-animations

title: AI Voice Chat
impact: Enabled seamless voice-first AI conversations with real-time transcription, playback, and interruption handling
description: A production-grade, voice-enabled AI assistant that allows users to hold full natural-language conversations using speech, with real-time transcription, LLM responses, and audio playback.
challenge: Building a seamless voice interface requires handling real-time transcription, low-latency responses, interruption control, and preventing feedback loops between input and output audio.
approach: Integrated browser speech APIs with a multi-provider LLM backend, focusing on real-time processing, interrupt handling, and audio feedback control to create a natural conversational experience.
solution: Developed a Next.js-based application that combines speech recognition, LLM orchestration, and speech synthesis to deliver a fully voice-driven interface with immersive live interaction modes.
features: Voice-first interaction with natural speech input
Live Mode with full-screen immersive call interface
Real-time speech recognition using Web Speech API
Text-to-speech playback via browser SpeechSynthesis
Interruptible AI responses that stop when user speaks
Echo cancellation using word-level matching to prevent feedback loops
Multi-provider LLM backend (Groq with Gemini fallback)
Type-safe API layer with Zod validation and structured error handling
Responsive UI across desktop and mobile browsers

title: AI Image Studio
impact: Empowered users to generate high-quality images from text prompts
description: An advanced AI-powered platform for generating and editing images using state-of-the-art text-to-image diffusion models.
challenge: Integrating complex generative AI APIs into a seamless user experience.
approach: Built a React frontend and Node.js backend to interface with OpenAI's DALL-E and Stable Diffusion APIs.
solution: Created an intuitive studio interface for prompt engineering, generation, and downloading.
features: Text-to-image generation
Image variation and editing
Prompt library and history

Automated image enhancement
Cloud storage integration for generated assets
